title: Pdf Artifact Spec Complete
description: Turn 📖️pdf (crate semio-s-artifact-stdio-pdf at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/📖️pdf) into a full-blown, feature-complete, ISO 32000-1 compliant artifact: typed page content (vector paths, graphics state, colour spaces, shadings, patterns, images/XObjects, text objects with real fonts incl. standard-14 metrics and embedded TrueType/CID fonts with ToUnicode), annotations, outlines, metadata; importable (content-stream parser into the typed model, resources resolved), exportable (writer emits fonts/images/resources and valid xref), editable over mutations (page/content/font/image/annotation/outline/info mutations with diff + inverse), and consumed by every plugin that produces PDF (draw, layout, …) instead of hand-painted bytes.
note: Ticket bookkeeping manual on disk: repo MCP timed out at session start (2026-09-18). Related: 26/09/05/DRAW-PLUGIN-END-TO-END (draw paints its own PDF), 26/09/18/LAYOUT-PDF-EXPORT-END-TO-END (layout paints its own PDF).
